location.en: Maple Bay International Airport, baggage claim
location.zh: 楓灣國際機場，行李提領區

goal.en: Find the right carousel and get your own suitcase back.
goal.zh: 找到正確的行李轉盤，拿回自己的行李箱。

background: wide airport baggage claim hall with several empty luggage carousels, metal conveyor belts, rows of empty luggage carts, blank overhead screens, tall windows, gray carpet, morning light

intro.en: You made it through immigration! Now you just need your suitcase. But there are five carousels, and you have no idea which one is yours.
intro.zh: 你通過入境審查了！現在只要拿到行李箱就好。可是這裡有五個轉盤，你完全不知道哪個才是你的。

intro.en: A staff member in an orange vest is busy talking into her walkie-talkie.
intro.zh: 一位穿橘色背心的工作人員正忙著用對講機講話。

lines.en: Copy that. Carousel two is clear. Over.
lines.zh: 收到。二號轉盤已清空，完畢。

choices.en: Excuse me, where are the bags from Taipei?
choices.zh: 不好意思，請問台北來的行李在哪裡？
choices.tip: 先用 Excuse me 引起注意，再用 where is / where are 問地點。

choices.en: Please ask, the luggage from Taipei is where?
choices.zh: 請問，台北來的行李是在哪裡？

lines.en: Please ask...? Ask who? Sorry, what's your question?
lines.zh: 請……問？問誰？抱歉，你的問題是什麼？

story.en: Grace waits for your real question, but her radio crackles again and she hurries off. You wander from carousel to carousel for twenty minutes.
story.zh: 葛蕾絲等著你把問題說清楚，但對講機又響了，她匆匆離開。你在轉盤之間繞了二十分鐘。

fail.why: 「請問」直譯成 Please ask，聽起來像「請你去問」。要引起注意就說 Excuse me，而且英文問句要把 where 放在最前面：Excuse me, where are the bags from Taipei?

choices.en: Hey you! Where is my bag? Tell me.
choices.zh: 喂，你！我的包包在哪？告訴我。

lines.en: Wow. Okay. The information desk is over there.

story.en: She points at a desk at the far end of the hall and turns away. The line at the information desk is very, very long.
story.zh: 她指了指大廳最遠處的服務台就轉身走了。服務台前的隊伍非常、非常長。

fail.why: 對陌生人喊 Hey you! 還用命令句 Tell me，聽起來像在使喚人。向工作人員求助時，先說 Excuse me，再禮貌地問 where is...?

lines.en: From Taipei? That's carousel four, right behind you.
lines.zh: 台北來的？在四號轉盤，就在你後面。

lines.en: At carousel four, a man in a gray suit grabs a black suitcase. It looks exactly like yours.
lines.zh: 在四號轉盤旁，一位穿灰色西裝的男子拎起一個黑色行李箱。那個箱子跟你的一模一樣。

lines.en: Finally! Okay, time to go home.

choices.en: Excuse me, I think that's mine.
choices.zh: 不好意思，我想那是我的。
choices.tip: I think 讓語氣變委婉；mine 是「我的東西」，後面不用再接名詞。

choices.en: Excuse me, I think that is my.
choices.zh: 不好意思，我想那是我的。

lines.en: That is your... what? Sorry, I'm in a hurry.
lines.zh: 那是你的……什麼？抱歉，我在趕時間。

story.en: He waits for the rest of your sentence, then shrugs and rolls the suitcase away. You chase him all the way to the taxi line.
story.zh: 他等你把話說完，最後聳聳肩，拖著箱子走了。你一路追到計程車招呼站。

fail.why: my 後面一定要接名詞，例如 my bag。單獨使用、後面沒有名詞時要用 mine：I think that's mine.

choices.en: Stop! Thief! That's my bag, not yours!
choices.zh: 站住！小偷！那是我的包，不是你的！

lines.en: Thief? Excuse me? I picked it up by mistake!
lines.zh: 小偷？你說什麼？我只是拿錯了！

story.en: Everyone at the carousel turns to stare. Airport security walks over, and it takes ten long minutes to clear things up.
story.zh: 轉盤旁的人全都轉頭看你。機場警衛走了過來，花了漫長的十分鐘才把事情講清楚。

fail.why: 對方很可能只是拿錯，直接喊 Thief! 太衝了。先用 Excuse me, I think that's mine. 委婉提醒，I think 能幫你留餘地。

lines.en: Yours? Are you sure? Mine is black, too.
lines.zh: 你的？你確定嗎？我的也是黑色的。

choices.en: Yes, this is mine. See the name tag?
choices.tip: This is mine. 直接表明所有權，再請對方看證據 See the name tag?

choices.en: Sure! You look look the name tag.

lines.en: Look look? Look at what, exactly?

story.en: He looks at the ceiling, then at the floor, then at you. By the time he finds the tag, the taxi line outside is twice as long.
story.zh: 他看看天花板，又看看地板，再看看你。等他終於找到名牌時，外面排計程車的隊伍已經長了一倍。

fail.why: 中文「看看」直譯成 look look 不是英文。請對方看某樣東西要說 Look at the tag.，或用問句 See the name tag?

choices.en: Yes! Black is my favorite color, too!
choices.zh: 對！黑色也是我最喜歡的顏色！

lines.en: ...Nice. So is this your bag or not?
lines.zh: ……真好。所以這到底是不是你的包？

story.en: He decides the bag must be his and leaves. Ten minutes later, he comes back red-faced with your suitcase. His was still on the belt.
story.zh: 他認定那是自己的包就走了。十分鐘後，他滿臉通紅地把你的行李箱拖回來，原來他的還在轉盤上。

fail.why: 對方問的是「你確定嗎」，不是在聊喜歡的顏色。要確認所有權就說 Yes, this is mine.，再拿名牌當證據。

lines.en: Oh! Your name is on it. I'm so sorry about that!
lines.zh: 喔！上面有你的名字。真的很抱歉！

lines.en: A minute later, his twin suitcase rolls out onto the belt. You both laugh.
lines.zh: 一分鐘後，他那個一模一樣的行李箱滑上了轉盤。你們兩個都笑了。

story.en: You get your suitcase back, and Dan gets his. You tie a bright red ribbon on yours so this never happens again.
story.zh: 你拿回了自己的行李箱，丹也找到了他的。你在箱子上綁了一條鮮紅色緞帶，以後再也不會拿錯。

notes.explain: 向陌生人求助的萬用開頭。Excuse me 先引起注意，再接 where is（單數）或 where are（複數）。

example.en: Excuse me, where is the restroom?
example.zh: 不好意思，請問洗手間在哪裡？

notes.zh: 「請問」要說 Excuse me，不是 Please ask
notes.explain: 「請問」只是禮貌的開場，英文用 Excuse me。Please ask 的意思是「請你去問」，對方會一頭霧水。

example.zh: 請問五號登機門在哪裡？

notes.explain: my、your 後面一定要接名詞；後面沒有名詞時，改用 mine、yours。

example.en: This is my bag. This bag is mine.
example.zh: 這是我的包包。這個包包是我的。

notes.explain: 對方可能只是拿錯，用 I think 開頭比直接說 That's mine! 委婉，也給對方台階下。

example.en: Excuse me, I think that's my umbrella.
example.zh: 不好意思，我想那是我的雨傘。

notes.explain: 行李轉盤上長得一樣的箱子很多。先禮貌確認、請對方看名牌，比大喊 Thief! 有效得多。綁上顯眼的吊牌或緞帶，能避免被拿錯。

example.en: Sorry, could you check the name tag?
example.zh: 不好意思，可以看一下名牌嗎？
